title: Pool Party in Caverns of Memory (Fiesta en la Piscina)
names_seen: Pool Party in Caverns of Memory (Fiesta en la Piscina)

facts.statement: A community event pool party was held in the pools beneath the Caverns of Memory, with dancing, confetti cannons and swimming; it ran on Server 1.
facts.quote: Acompaña al equipo comunitario y todos tus amigos de Free Realms a las piscinas que se ubican debajo de las Cavernas del Recuerdo

facts.statement: The US and Latin America session was Thursday 20 January 2011 at 15:00 Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 20 de enero del 2011 15:00 Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was Friday 21 January 2011 at 09:00 Pacific Time (16:00 European Time) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Viernes 21 de enero del 2011 09:00 Tiempo Pacifico / 16:00 Tiempo Europeo (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice announcing a pool party in the Caverns of Memory, beneath the Sanctuary caves, run by the community team on Server 1. It gives the event times for the Americas and Europe in January 2011 and says the Caverns can be reached from anywhere in the game via the atlas teleport to the Forgotten Caves battle.
